description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EndpointV2SerializerTrait' used within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides helper functions to set endpoints, headers, and schemes for HTTP requests during dynamic endpoint resolution, mainly used internally for serialization and endpoint configuration.

methods.name: setEndpointV2RequestOptions
methods.description: Sets endpoint URL, headers, and scheme in request options based on a RulesetEndpoint, modifying headers array and endpoint property.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Merges endpoint-specific headers into the existing headers array if present.

methods.name: applyScheme
methods.description: Replaces the scheme of the resolved URL with a custom scheme if specified in the endpoint or the current endpoint Uri object.
